headline: Apple reportedly plans touchscreen MacBook launch this month
summary: Apple is reportedly set to debut its first touchscreen MacBook Pro and an updated iPad Mini around October 27th, according to a Bloomberg report, roughly two weeks after Apple's smart-home-focused October 13th event.
